summary: First full E2E run of ESPACIO Q Phase 1 (Next.js 14 + Mongo, FastAPI proxy). Backend: 23/23 pytest pass (OpenAPI, availability rules, 10-way concurrency, 'any'-pro concurrency = capacity, overlap 409, idempotency replay, manage reschedule/cancel/rebook, concurrent reschedule to same slot -> [200,409], invalid token, closed/past/beyond-horizon rejection, reminder+confirmation jobs, internal jobs auth, admin API guards). Frontend UI tested: public pages JRN-1 (all 200, no broken images), /acceso login-only, owner login -> /admin, logout -> /admin redirects + old cookie invalid, full /reservar wizard -> success screen -> appointment in /admin/agenda -> slot removed, manage page reschedule (UI) + cancel (UI) + slot freed, invalid token page, CMS draft (not public) -> publish (public) -> revision history -> reverted, media upload PNG ok + /media/<file> served (image/png), SVG & fake .jpg rejected with Spanish error, newsletter consent required + PENDING_VERIFICATION + NEWSLETTER_VERIFY SIMULATED_LOCAL outbox, contact invalid/valid + CONTACT_ACK outbox + message in /admin/informes, clients template/dry-run/import (3 rows, '=' cell, marketing off)/export with formula neutralised, RECEPTION denied on /admin/configuracion (+integraciones), agenda usable. All requested journeys pass; issues found are security/UX/minor.

critical.issue: Rate-limit identity = FIRST entry of client-controlled X-Forwarded-For. Verified: ingress forwards client XFF unchanged (11 requests with fixed spoofed XFF -> 11th 429; rotating XFF -> 18+ bookings with no 429). Booking/contact/newsletter limits AND the login brute-force limit (ip|email, 8/15min) are fully bypassable by rotating the header.

minor.issue: Successful logins count toward the 8/15min login limit; after ~8 legit logins the owner got 'Demasiados intentos' with correct password. Count only failures or reset on success.
Invalid email returns zod default English 'Invalid email' (shown in Spanish UI). Add Spanish messages like the booking schema.
Nonexistent serviceId returns 409 SLOT_UNAVAILABLE instead of 400/404.
No session returns 403 (not 401). Acceptable per JRN-5 but 401 is more correct for unauthenticated.
Neutralisation stores a literal leading apostrophe in string cells ("'+34 600...", "'=HYPERLINK..."), visible in Excel. Consider quotePrefix style instead of literal char for phones.
Served with Cache-Control: no-store for immutable uniquely-named files (perf only).

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration errors #418/#423/#425 (7 pageerrors) only on '/'. Likely client/server divergent render in perspective-tunnel-hero (useReducedMotion / matchMedia branching) or locale/date text. Other public pages clean.
Same-day slot list hides slots overlapping the appointment's own current window (e.g. 11:00-12:45 when booked 12:00), so moving by 15 min isn't possible although backend supports self-overlap.

issues: Black Friday promo modal pops over every page after a delay incl. /reservar wizard and /reservar/gestion cancel page, blocking clicks until closed
Cookie banner sometimes persists after clicking Aceptar right after load (pre-hydration click)
Native <input type=date> picker used (not shadcn calendar)
Admin CMS publish uses native window.confirm()
No data-testid attributes anywhere (imported repo) - tests rely on ids/text

action_items: Derive client IP from a trusted hop (rightmost XFF entry added by ingress / x-real-ip) instead of the first XFF entry, in getClientIdentifier and loginAction
Do not count successful logins toward the login rate limit
Add Spanish zod messages for contact/newsletter email (and other fields)
Fix hydration mismatch on home page
Return 400/404 for unknown serviceId in booking create
Optional: allow reschedule to slots overlapping own appointment in manage UI; limit promo popup on transactional pages

rca of the issue: XFF bypass: getClientIdentifier() takes fwd.split(',')[0]; the Emergent ingress/Cloudflare appends the real IP but keeps the client-supplied value first, so the attacker controls the key. Repro: send 11 POST /api/v1/bookings with header X-Forwarded-For: 203.0.113.7 -> 11th 429; change header -> allowed again. Mitigation: use the last (rightmost) XFF entry or a trusted header set by the edge (e.g. cf-connecting-ip / x-real-ip), and apply the same in loginAction.
